'''Sav Darnell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was captured on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and interrogated. However, Darnell and others escaped and managed to take control of the prison after Darnell discovered his Force-sensitivity and used the dark side to kill his captors. An Imperial spacer sent by [[Gorn Sweevas]] defeated Darnell and executed him.<ref name="SWTOR" />
